android.desc:
Tired of losing useful reels, videos, and social clips in cluttered chats and endless bookmarks?

Link Vault is your smart visual library to save, organize, and rediscover your favorite reels, videos, and articles in one tap. Save content directly from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and browsers with automatic high-resolution cover extraction, clean titles, and instant local AI summaries.

⚡ 1-TAP INSTANT SAVE
• Universal Share Target: Tap "Share" from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, or Chrome to save instantly in the background without leaving your feed.
• Automatic Cover & Title Extraction: Automatically extracts high-resolution thumbnails, clean video titles, and descriptions without manual typing.
• Smart Clipboard Detection: Automatically detects copied video links the moment you open the app for effortless saving.
• Clean Tracking URLs: Automatically strips annoying tracking tags (UTM, fbclid, igshid) to keep your links clean and private.

🧠 BUILT-IN ON-DEVICE AI (FREE & ZERO SETUP)
• Instant Video Summaries: Automatically generates clear takeaways and core points from saved content using built-in on-device AI.
• Smart Auto-Tagging: Intelligently categorizes and tags your videos so you can find them in seconds.
• Conversational Search: Chat directly with your vault to find specific topics: "Find that cooking recipe from last week" or "Show marketing reels".
• Pro Flexibility: Optional support for custom API keys or local models for power users.

🗂️ CLEAN VISUAL LIBRARY & OFFLINE ACCESS
• Visual Grid & List Views: Browse your saved clips with modern card previews, rich thumbnails, and tags.
• 100% Offline Search: Instant SQLite full-text search across titles, summaries, and tags without requiring an internet connection.
• Free Google Drive Backup: Secure, private backup and restore directly through your personal Google Drive.
• Private Vault: Lock confidential clips, notes, and links behind fingerprint or PIN protection.

Stop letting great content slip away. Download Link Vault today and turn scattered reels and videos into your organized personal media vault!
